item.description: New: Dak brings your Gmail to the Mac, kept on the Mac so it opens at once, and worked from the keyboard. A first version, to use beside Gmail, not yet in its place. It holds your inbox and what arrives from now on; older, archived mail stays in Gmail. A sent message waits ten seconds, so ⌘Z can bring it back; Send Later and Remind Me Later hold a message or a conversation for another hour. Google asks you to sign in again every seven days for now, and only the addresses listed on Dak's own Google project can sign in.
